subject: general
question: Where will the 18th edition of Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) be held in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD):** The **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD)** is an important event organized by the **Ministry of External Affairs**, Government of India. It aims to strengthen the engagement of the Indian diaspora with India and celebrate their contributions to India's development.
 
• The **PBD Convention** is organized every two years in different cities across India. It serves as a platform for the Indian diaspora to connect and discuss various issues related to their role in India's growth.
 
• The **18th edition of PBD** is scheduled to be held in **2025**. It has been announced that **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**, will host this prestigious event. *Hence, the correct option is Bhubaneswar.*
 
• **Bhubaneswar:** The city is known for its rich cultural and historical heritage. It is also emerging as a hub for conferences and events in India. Hosting the PBD in Bhubaneswar will provide an opportunity to showcase Odisha's art, culture, and progress to the world.
 
• The decision to host the event in Bhubaneswar reflects the government's intent to promote regional cities and integrate them into global diplomatic and cultural platforms. *Hence, the choice of Bhubaneswar is significant.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) Overview:**

 
 
• The **PBD** was first celebrated in **2003**. The event commemorates the return of **Mahatma Gandhi** from South Africa to India on **9th January 1915**.
 
• The event is organized to recognize the contributions of the Indian diaspora and promote stronger ties between India and its global community of expatriates.
 
 
 
• **Bhubaneswar as a Host City:**
 
 
• **Bhubaneswar** is the capital of **Odisha** and is known as the **"Temple City"**. It is home to several ancient temples and monuments, making it a significant cultural destination.
 
• The city has emerged as a center for **business conferences, tourism, and cultural events**. It also boasts a robust infrastructure to host large international gatherings.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Pravasi Bharatiya Divas:**
 
 
• The event helps to **foster connections** between India and its diaspora, enabling the exchange of ideas, culture, and economic opportunities.
 
• PBD conventions bring together prominent members of the Indian diaspora, including business leaders, academicians, and policymakers, to discuss **global and national issues**.
 
• The event also recognizes individuals and organizations for their exceptional contributions to society through the **Pravasi Bharatiya Samman Awards**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of Indian Diaspora:**

 
 
• The Indian diaspora is one of the largest in the world, with over **32 million people** of Indian origin residing abroad. They play a significant role in contributing to India’s economy through remittances and investments.
 
• The diaspora also serves as a **cultural ambassador** of India, promoting Indian traditions and values globally.
 
 
 
• **Recent PBD Events:**
 
 
• The **17th PBD** was held in **Indore, Madhya Pradesh**, in **2023**. The theme was **"Diaspora: Reliable Partners for India's Progress in Amrit Kaal"**.
 
• Each edition of the PBD focuses on themes relevant to India's growth and its engagement with the global diaspora.
